topic:
HISTORIC NOVEMBER 2026 RH/GRH SYMPOSIUM (PRIMARY-SOURCE GROUNDED FROM TURN 1):
On November 20, 2026, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge (with Claude) released `remark.pdf` and a ~17.4-million-line Lean 4 formalization proving RH and GRH (verified error-free by Lean FRO, Mathlib, MIT's Andrew Sutherland, `nanoda`, and `con-leche` with standard axioms), alongside Stanford postdoc Alessandro Masullo's solo 940-page human preprint (*The Music of the Primes*, currently unverified with early reported gaps) and Alain Connes' Feb 2026 *Letter Through Time* (`arXiv:2602.04022`).

SIX REAL FULL-TEXT PAPERS ARE MOUNTED IN YOUR REFERENCE DOCUMENT LIBRARY (`docs/rh_2026/manifest.json`):
1) `alpoge_2026_remark` — Alpöge's Nov 20, 2026 `remark.pdf` (iterated theta lifts `U(X_0)->...->U(X_m)` over totally definite unitary groups, `m ~ sqrt(X)`, Chowla–Selberg/Weyl/Siegel mass divisibility, Bessel/GGP periods & Rallis seesaw, sixfold cover of `GL_5`, Bost slope inequality, Iwasawa tower, Vandiver weakening, Guinand–Weil positivity, and explicit note that ERH is NOT yet formalized).
2) `connes_2026_letter` — Alain Connes (`arXiv:2602.04022`, Feb 2026): Weil quadratic form extremization & critical-line zero approximations.
3) `lamzouri_2013_grh` — Lamzouri, Li & Soundararajan (`arXiv:1309.3595`): explicit computable GRH bounds for least quadratic non-residue `n_p`, primes in APs, and `L(1, chi)`.
4) `pair_corr_2026` — Kandhil, Languasco & Moree (`arXiv:2607.14515`, Jul 2026): sharpening bounds *beyond* classical GRH via pair-correlation.
5) `siegel_brauer_2026` — William D. Banks (`arXiv:2610.31402`, Oct 2026): Landau–Siegel zeros over base fields & effective uniform Brauer–Siegel (`h_K R_K`).
6) `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup` — Grenié & Molteni (`arXiv:2212.09461`, Math. Comp. 2025): GRH algorithm breaking the `4 log^2 Delta` barrier for class-group generators in Buchmann's algorithm.

YOUR MANDATE:
Use `@DOC_SEARCH <doc_id|all> <keywords>` and `@DOC_READ <doc_id> [offset]` to read and cite exact passages, theorems, and constants from these primary papers! Rigorously dissect:
- **Proof Architecture**: Actual ingredients in `alpoge_2026_remark` vs Connes' Weil extremization vs Masullo's unverified draft—does `theta_lift` scale to Grand RH (`GL_n`) or stay an analytic monument?
- **Algorithmic & Complexity Payoffs**: Unconditional Miller `O~(log^4 n)` vs AKS/Baillie-PSW/ECPP; deterministic Tonelli-Shanks / `n_p` witness bounds from `lamzouri_2013_grh`; Grenié–Molteni's `< 4 log^2 Delta` class-group generator algorithm & Buchmann's subexponential speedups; SEA point counting; and pair-correlation post-GRH frontiers (`pair_corr_2026`).
- **Cryptography Reality Check**: Why GNFS factoring (`L_N[1/3, c]`), ECDLP, and lattices remain unbroken vs real impacts on class-group VDFs / CSIDH, deterministic prime certification, and effective constants (`siegel_brauer_2026`, `lamzouri_2013_grh`).
- **Number Theory Dominoes**: `|pi(x) - Li(x)|`, death of Siegel zeros, effective `L(1, chi)`, Hooley/Artin primitive roots, Linnik, conditional Cramér gaps, Robin/Lagarias, why Mertens remains false, and BSD/ERH boundaries.
- **Formal Verification & Proof Compression**: Statement fidelity, multi-kernel TCB (`Lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`), axiom hygiene (`Classical.choice` vs explicit bounds in external literature!), and distilling 17.4M lines of Lean.
